text:
nora (product): Flag from usability testing: users want a quick in-table preview without leaving compare. They hit the kebab too often and expect a tiny readout.
anya (design): Proposal: a compact hover/peek card that shows model name, current pinned version, tiny perf pills (p95 + cost), and a small 'Open' action. Hover for mouse, focus for keyboard.
kai (fe): Technical note: make the peek lazy-loaded and cache per session. For touch devices, tap the kebab to show the same card.
matt (eng): Agree on lazy load. We can reuse the existing model-summary endpoint but add a ?peek=true param to reduce payload. Rate-limit at 10 req/s per user to be safe.
amanda (a11y): Accessibility: peek card must be reachable via keyboard (focusable element). Use aria-live polite for dynamic content and ensure Esc closes it. Do not trap focus unless user opens a full modal.
anya (design): Microcopy decision: label the pin action as "Pin version" and show scope in the peek: "Pinned to: Route /api/v1/generate" if applicable. Also a micro thumbtack icon next to version.
ora (product): Good. Also users asked to toggle between compact and comfortable density with a header control. Shortcut suggestion: press 'D' to toggle density.
kai (fe): I'll implement a button and keyboard handler. Will include a visible outline when density is compact. Need design token for dense row height.
amanda (a11y): Shortcut okay if discoverable. Add a tooltip with the shortcut and include it in the keyboard help modal. Announce density change: "Compact density enabled" via aria-live.
matt (eng): Action items: 1) @anya deliver peek mock + dense token, 2) @kai implement lazy peek + density toggle, 3) @amanda run a11y checklist, 4) I'll add the ?peek=true API param and rate-limits. ETA next sprint.
